selector.rationale: The gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue obtained from curettage supports the diagnosis of periapical granuloma, which is also consistent with the mild periapical radiolucency and the absence of tenderness on percussion.

rejected.label: Periapical abscess
rejected.why: The absence of a frank abscess and the nature of the tissue obtained from curettage do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Gingival cyst of the adult
rejected.why: The presence of grossly carious teeth and the location of the swelling suggest a periapical rather than a gingival origin.

rejected.label: Mucous retention cyst
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and the histopathological findings do not support the diagnosis of a mucous retention cyst.
